Cobalt's net balance of 18779 matches my check: orders 19506 + 2421 = 21927, minus the 3148 refund on order 192. All three balances are verified, so I'll record the payouts, starting with acme at 33841.
Acme's payout is recorded. Next is birch, whose verified net balance is 40664, so I'll record that payout.
Acme and birch are recorded. Cobalt's verified net balance is 18779, so I'll record its payout to finish the batch.
